decisive_items: Biopsy of the umbilical lesion demonstrated a well-differentiated, infiltrating adenocarcinoma

Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT showed homogeneously enhancing umbilical tissue growth and irregular, circumferential thickening of the right third of the transverse colon measuring approximately 8.3 cm
Total colonoscopy revealed no endoluminal lesion
response.rationale: Umbilical adenocarcinoma with CT evidence of transverse colon wall thickening, despite no endoluminal lesion, best fits metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma presenting as a Sister Mary Joseph nodule. No alternative candidate was supplied.
